name: flutter_inappwebview
//: Publish order: publish:annotations, publish:platform_interface, publish:android and publish:ios (either order), publish:plugin.
Publish one package at a time and check that pub.dev serves it before the next.
publish:dry dry-runs all five in that order, reports each, and exits non-zero if any failed.
Expected: 0 warnings, and the hint "Non-dev dependencies are overridden in pubspec.yaml" (0/1/2/2/4 in publish order).
The dependency_overrides are path overrides between the five packages, so the repo builds while their versions move together;
pub ignores a dependency's overrides, so apps using the published packages never see them.

scripts.build: cd flutter_inappwebview_platform_interface && fvm dart run build_runner build
scripts.watch: cd flutter_inappwebview_platform_interface && fvm dart run build_runner watch
scripts.publish:dry: fail=0; for d in dev_packages/flutter_inappwebview_internal_annotations flutter_inappwebview_platform_interface flutter_inappwebview_android nosferatu500_inappwebview_ios flutter_inappwebview; do echo "== $d"; (cd "$d" && fvm flutter pub publish --dry-run) || { echo "!! $d: dry run failed"; fail=1; }; done; exit $fail
scripts.format: fvm dart format flutter_inappwebview/lib flutter_inappwebview/example/integration_test flutter_inappwebview_platform_interface/lib flutter_inappwebview_android/lib nosferatu500_inappwebview_ios/lib
scripts.docs:serve: fvm flutter pub global activate dhttpd && fvm flutter pub global run dhttpd:dhttpd --path doc/api
scripts.publish:annotations: cd dev_packages/flutter_inappwebview_internal_annotations && fvm flutter pub publish && cd ../..
scripts.publish:platform_interface: cd flutter_inappwebview_platform_interface && fvm flutter pub publish && cd ..
scripts.publish:android: cd flutter_inappwebview_android && fvm flutter pub publish && cd ..
scripts.publish:ios: cd nosferatu500_inappwebview_ios && fvm flutter pub publish && cd ..
scripts.publish:all_platforms: npm run publish:android && npm run publish:ios
scripts.publish:interface_and_all_platforms: npm run publish:platform_interface && npm run publish:all_platforms
scripts.publish:plugin: cd flutter_inappwebview && fvm flutter pub publish && cd ..

author: Lorenzo Pichilli
